messages:
Samir Patel: quick check — we have a partner announcement blocked on security artifacts. legal wants a clear handoff for SOC2 + pen report + questionnaire answers. who owns the upload + redaction?
Maria Gomez: I can own the redaction checklist and final review. will need the raw reports by EOD Wed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon Lee: i can coordinate the presigned uploads to the partner bucket. two questions: 1) do we need full pen test or a redacted summary for the joint announcement? 2) who signs the attestation?
Ashley R.: legal prefers redacted pen with tester name + scope + findings count, not raw exploit docs. SOC2 PDF ok to include if we presign and set TTL. attestation should be from Partnerships (Samir) + Security (Ash).
Samir Patel: noted. plan: Devon -> presigned links (7d TTL), Maria -> redaction + final copy, Ashley -> security attestation. I'll do the partner-facing signature.
Devon Lee: making the upload plan now. will create folder: s3://redwood-partners/publishing/partner-acme-2025/ and presign links. command i'll run:```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partners/publishing/partner-acme-2025/soc2.pdf --expires-in 604800```
Maria Gomez: redaction rules: remove IPs, hostnames, internal ticket IDs, full stack traces, PII. keep: scope, date, auditor name (can be redacted to firm only if partner requires). i'll push a redaction checklist to the folder.
integrator-bot: Reminder: upload policy requires a manifest.json with fields: owner, doc_type, redacted (true/false), expiry. Missing manifest will block listing.
Ashley R.: security note — if pen test includes firmware or HW details, escalate to eng-hw before redacting. we can't over-redact security-sensitive mitigations.
Samir Patel: good call. Devon, ping eng-hw if any binary/firmware artifacts. Maria, add a line in the checklist: "escalate firmware disclosures to eng-hw@redwood".
Devon Lee: uploaded draft presign links to the channel (private partner thread). will also attach manifest template.
Maria Gomez: uploading redaction checklist v0.2 to the folder. tagging @Ashley R. for the firmware clause review.
Ashley R.: reviewed checklist. suggest adding a brief note for external SI partners: they must sign NDA covering artifact handling before we provide raw logs. add an NDA_needed boolean to manifest.
Samir Patel: done. i've updated the partner onboarding doc to require NDA flag. next steps: Devon finalize presigns, Maria finalize redaction, Ashley prepare attestation email template. target: Thursday 11am PT for partner delivery.
Devon Lee: timeline works. will post final presigns here when ready.
Maria Gomez: will aim to deliver redacted artifacts by Wed 6pm PT.
integrator-bot: Action items created: #A-3493 (Devon: presign upload), #A-3494 (Maria: redaction checklist), #A-3495 (Ashley: attestation email).
Samir Patel: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. i'll follow up with partner comms draft once artifacts are live. :thumbsup:
